title: Sumerian astronomical knowledge
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sumerian astronomical knowledge, about ancient at Sumer, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You have Sumerian um architecture that shows a precocious knowledge of astronomy.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the buildings of the Sumerians, one of the earliest known civilizations of the ancient Middle East, show a surprisingly advanced knowledge of astronomy. He raises it as a puzzle, since it would mean an ancient people knew more about the sky than we expect.
